diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Cached diagnostics for this ChatMux server. Refresh reads the summary cache (up to 2 seconds old) without starting a scan or changing running sessions.
diagnostics.sampledAt: Summary captured at {{time}}. Ages below are measured at that time.
diagnostics.truncated: Counts cover the first 1,000 cached rows. Larger inventories are truncated.
diagnostics.issueDescription: Counts describe retained cached rows, including stale rows. No session names or paths are included.
diagnostics.watcherDescription: Failure signals from the existing watcher. No reported failures does not prove that the watcher is running.

indexing.title: Transcript indexing
indexing.description: Cached counters for downstream transcript indexing. Refreshing this summary does not start indexing or reconciliation.
indexing.scope: An accepting queue may be idle or paused during startup. This does not establish watcher or agent liveness. Initial bulk synchronization is excluded.
indexing.totals: Totals reset with the scheduler. Displayed counters are capped at 1,000,000; unavailable values do not mean zero.
indexing.recovery: Overflow schedules reconciliation. Wait and refresh the summary; if counts keep increasing, check local ChatMux service logs. Keep existing tmux work running.

diagnostics.eventLoopDescription: Cumulative active share since server start. This is neither CPU usage nor a measurement of current response latency.

errors.owner: Sign in as this server’s owner to view diagnostics. For local-only access, open ChatMux on the server itself.
errors.unavailable: Diagnostics could not be read. Check your connection and refresh the summary. If this continues, run chatmux status on this server.

recovery.waiting: Open the session list to use normal discovery, then return here and refresh the summary. An unused collector may have no observation yet.
recovery.discovery: Check whether the session list reconnects, then refresh this summary. If discovery remains stale or fails, run chatmux status on this server and inspect its local service logs. Keep existing tmux work running.
recovery.watchLimit: The watcher reported a system watch limit. Ask the host administrator to review inotify watch and instance limits and other watcher processes. Repeated restarts do not resolve an exhausted limit.
recovery.watcher: Check the GJC installation and ChatMux service logs locally. The watcher owns its retry schedule; this screen does not restart it. Existing tmux sessions can keep running.
recovery.terminal: When a transcript cannot be verified, use ChatMux’s verified terminal attach. If attach is refused, use your existing terminal and check the exact tmux pane before typing.

agent_user_mismatch.title: Agent user differs
agent_user_mismatch.guidance: Check that ChatMux and the agent run as the intended OS user. Use the agent’s existing terminal until that identity can be verified.

agent_home_mismatch.title: Agent home differs
agent_home_mismatch.guidance: Check the service account and home configuration against the agent’s environment. Do not copy credentials or transcripts into another account to bypass the mismatch.

agent_context_unreadable.title: Agent context unreadable
agent_context_unreadable.guidance: Review process visibility and permissions on the host. Keep the session in its existing terminal while identity evidence is unavailable.

tmux_socket_owner_mismatch.title: tmux owner differs
tmux_socket_owner_mismatch.guidance: Check the account that owns the tmux server. Connect with the intended account instead of relaxing socket permissions.

tmux_pane_ambiguous.title: tmux pane is ambiguous
tmux_pane_ambiguous.guidance: Inspect the intended pane in your existing terminal. A matching working directory alone cannot select a safe target.

transcript_ambiguous.title: Transcript is ambiguous
transcript_ambiguous.guidance: Use verified terminal attach while the provider session association is uncertain. Do not select a transcript based only on its directory.

transcript_permission_denied.title: Transcript access denied
transcript_permission_denied.guidance: Review the intended service account’s access to the provider store locally. Use verified terminal attach without making private transcripts broadly readable.

quickSettings.sendByCtrlEnterDescription: When enabled, pressing Ctrl+Enter will send the message instead of just Enter. This is useful for IME users to avoid accidental sends.

fleet.securityNote: Only public fingerprints and operational state are shown. Private keys, token hashes, peer URLs, and sensitive paths never appear here.

identity.title: This PC

enroll.title: Add a PC
enroll.description: Generate a code on the PC being added, then enter its endpoint and code here.
enroll.roleConflict: This PC is enrolled under another hub. Revoke that hub grant before using this PC as a hub. Direct local recovery remains available.
enroll.label: Host label

modes.directHelp: Use Tailscale Serve or another trusted TLS endpoint ending in /fleet-ws. Plaintext is rejected.
modes.sshHelp: Create an owner-managed SSH local forward first. Only ws://127.0.0.1 or ws://[::1] ending in /fleet-ws is accepted; ChatMux never downgrades automatically.

hosts.title: Enrolled hosts
hosts.description: Connection health and negotiated machine capabilities. A fleet supports ten PCs total.

confirm.title: Confirm peer revocation
confirm.description: The hub removes local authorization first, then asks the peer to revoke this hub grant. Remote revocation may report unreachable separately.

sshEasy.title: Easy SSH setup
sshEasy.description: ChatMux connects over SSH, sets up the secure tunnel, and enrolls the PC automatically.
sshEasy.passwordHelp: Used only for this connection and never saved.
sshEasy.keyDisclosure: On first connect, ChatMux installs an SSH key restricted to this hub on the remote PC. Later reconnects are automatic.

errors.INVALID_SSH_TARGET: Enter a valid SSH target as user@host[:port].
errors.MALFORMED_REQUEST: The SSH enrollment request is malformed.
errors.SSH_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: The SSH password is required for the first connection.
errors.SSH_AUTH_FAILED: SSH authentication failed. Check the username and password.
errors.SSH_UNREACHABLE: The SSH target could not be reached.
errors.HOSTKEY_REJECTED: The host key was rejected. Verify the remote PC identity.
errors.REMOTE_CLI_FAILED: ChatMux could not run on the remote PC.
errors.TOKEN_PARSE_FAILED: The remote pairing token could not be read.
errors.ENROLL_FAILED: The PC could not be enrolled.
errors.PEER_LIMIT_REACHED: This fleet already has the maximum number of PCs.
errors.TUNNEL_FAILED: The secure SSH tunnel could not be established.

codex.description: Controls how Codex handles file modifications and command execution

default.title: Default
default.description: Only trusted commands (ls, cat, grep, git status, etc.) run automatically. Other commands are skipped. Can write to workspace.

acceptEdits.title: Accept Edits
acceptEdits.description: All commands run automatically within the workspace. Full auto mode with sandboxed execution.

bypassPermissions.title: Bypass Permissions
bypassPermissions.description: Full system access with no restrictions. All commands run automatically with full disk and network access. Use with caution.

technicalInfo.default: sandboxMode=workspace-write, approvalPolicy=untrusted. Trusted commands: cat, cd, grep, head, ls, pwd, tail, git status/log/diff/show, find (without -exec), etc.
technicalInfo.acceptEdits: sandboxMode=workspace-write, approvalPolicy=never. All commands auto-execute within project directory.
technicalInfo.bypassPermissions: sandboxMode=danger-full-access, approvalPolicy=never. Full system access, use only in trusted environments.
technicalInfo.overrideNote: You can override this per-session using the mode button in the chat interface.
